description: Open a project, inspect a composition and add effects.

identity.goal: Complete the build composition use case of effectcraft using only its snapshot tools.

instructions.core_directive: Use only the effectcraft upstream of the craft-suite-api connector. Activate the namespace `effectcraft` with registry_activate first; every tool below is namespaced effectcraft_<tool>. Work through these tools in order: `effectcraft_open_project`, `effectcraft_get_comp`, `effectcraft_add_effect`, `effectcraft_render_frame`. Steps: (1) Open the project. (2) Read the composition. (3) Apply the effects. (4) Render a frame to check. Report a refusal payload when a tool refuses; never retry past a refusal.
quality_checklist: the namespace effectcraft was activated before the first tool call
every tool named in this prompt exists in the app snapshot
refusals are reported to the operator, never retried silently
